note: Primitive camping on two open grassy loops with gravel drives and pull-offs, beside the paved lot on Big Buffalo Road, with a privy. The 6-acre Heron Lake is across the road and Big Buffalo Creek beyond it. The area is reached on gravel past the end of the blacktop. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' = one primitive camping area (1 GIS point) on open grassy gravel loops beside the paved lot; free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; privy added. Pin is on it. Not waterfront confirmed (lake across the road). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 2023 map puts the primitive-camping and privy symbols at the parking lot by Heron Lake at the south end; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point (the stored pin) 33 m from the paved lot (layer 26, 'Paved', Allows_Trailers 'No'). Imagery: two open grass loops ringed by a gravel drive with several pull-off spurs, west of the gravel Big Buffalo Road - drive-in for a 23-ft rig, no ford on the approach from Route FF or WW. Spot length unpublished (caveat in note).
PIN: stored 38.33319,-93.08913 is the GIS camping point in the middle of the camping loop - fine.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the 6-acre Heron Lake (a lake by the 5-acre line) is ~110 m east of the loop across Big Buffalo Road and a wooded strip; the creek is ~200 m SE beyond the road. No view value earned (road between; canopy).
PHONE: (660) 530-5500 on the area page matches.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, the 14-day line and the directions dropped; the camping area described.
